case_number: Civil Appeal No. [NUMBER] OF 2023 (@ SLP (C) NO. 28377 OF 2018)
summary: Mortgage redemption claim; suit property shop; registered mortgage deed dated 12.02.1957; failure to redeem within 30 years; limitation under Article 61A of Limitation Act; dismissal of Small Cause Suit No. 3/2007 for non-prosecution; subsequent suit (No. 154/2009) under Section 83 of TP Act for redemption; amendment sought to plaint altering mortgage narrative to tenancy; amendment application under Order VI Rule 17 CPC rejected due to inconsistent pleadings; res judicata and limitation invoked by defendant; appeal against High Court's affirmation of amendment order.
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order VI Rule 17
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment permitting amendment of plaint set aside; dismissal of amendment application restored.
